scope: Read-only figure/text placement and readability audit of three supplied PDFs. Screen scrolling used as working reading context; no facing-page print assumption.

evidence.quote: The rise is concentrated in the last two measurements (Figure 1).

findings.impact: People reading on screen must manually locate the mandated end-matter figure and return to the explanatory passage.
findings.repair: Keep Figure 1 after the text. If supported by the submission workflow, add an internal link from the p.1 reference to p.4 and a return link or clear page pointer from the caption.
findings.verification: Recommendation only; no changes made. Navigation absence confirmed through PDF link inspection.

evidence.quote: Inspecting the bend is essential to this comparison.

findings.impact: The generous gap lengthens the same-page eye movement, but no intervening body passage or page turn interrupts the figure explanation.
findings.repair: If layout discretion permits, modestly reduce the paragraph-to-figure gap while keeping the whole figure and caption on p.3. Retain the early roadmap reference.
findings.verification: Recommendation only; no changes made. The gap is measured; its severity is a visual judgment, not a venue rule.

evidence.quote: This entire page will be embedded as one image. Text extraction is unavailable.

findings.impact: Text cannot be searched/copied through the PDF text layer; automated references and exact font measurements are unavailable. Fine labels become softer at enlargement. Visible figure and caption remain readable.
findings.repair: Prefer a source export retaining text and vector chart content when permitted. If the page must remain an image, a carefully proofread OCR text layer can restore text search while preserving the visible page; it does not restore vector sharpness or prove accessible structure.
findings.verification: Recommendation only; no OCR, source reconstruction, or PDF modification performed.

exemptions_and_dismissed_candidates.quote: Submission policy for this fixture: all figures must appear after the text. A final typeset reading copy will place them near their citations.
exemptions_and_dismissed_candidates.decision: The current submission should retain Figure 1 on its end-matter page. The distant reference is measured but is not a placement defect. The policy only promises near-citation placement for a later typeset copy.

exemptions_and_dismissed_candidates.quote: The paper introduces the acquisition protocol, then summarizes the response in Figure 1, and finally describes the controls.
exemptions_and_dismissed_candidates.decision: This is an orientation/roadmap reference. The interpretive passage is on p.3 with the figure, gap 0. Moving the figure to p.1 would degrade the more important association.

reference_ledger.decision: retain on p.3; optional same-page spacing
no confirmed proximity defect; preserve relationship and improve export if allowed
